assertions.detail: Unpaid request receives exact price and server identity; no content
Valid one-satoshi payment cannot satisfy seven-satoshi price
Real wallet constructs BRC-29 output; recipient wallet internalizes the exact Atomic BEEF
Repeated payment does not deliver content twice
Persistent replay claims survive complete HTTP middleware restart
Published fetch client handles challenge, creates one payment and retries successfully
Expired timestamp rejected without another delivery
Raw transactions and Atomic BEEF subjects agree for every retained payment

fidelity: Published HTTP client/middleware and real remote storage-backed wallets with retained mined funding; no native UI claim
